(M, Pr., 86); before voc., Mat.2:6, Luk.1:76, Jhn.17:5, al.; sometimes without…

G4750.definition: the mouth: of man, Mat.15:11, Jhn.19:29, Act.11:8, al.; of animals, Mat.17:27, 2Ti.4:17 (fig.), Heb.11:33, Jas.3:3, al.; figuratively, of inanimate things (ποταμοῦ, Hom.), ἤνοιξεν ἡ γῆ τὸ σ., Rev.12:16; σ. μαχαίρας (Heb. חֶרֶב ־פֶּה, Gen.34:26 al.), the edge of the sword, Luk.21:24, Heb.11:34; esp. of the mouth as the organ of speech: opposite to καρδία, Mat.12:34, Rom.10:8, 10; in various phrases (some cl., some…

G4762.definition: to turn: with accusative of thing(s) dative of person(s), Mat.5:39; = ἀποσ-, to bring back, Mat.27:3 (cf. Isa.38:8); reflexively (WM, § 38, 1), to turn oneself, Act.7:42; with accusative before εἰς, = μετασ-, to change, Rev.11:6. Pass., reflexive, to turn oneself: before εἰς, Jhn.20:14, Act.7:39 13:46; ptcp., στραφείς, with indic., Mat.7:6 9:22 16:23, Luk.7:9 9:55 14:25 22:61, Jhn.1:38 20:16; id. before πρός…

G4728.definition: narrow: fig (v MM, xxiii), Mat.7:13-14, Luk.13:24.†; (AS)

G4718.definition: a bunch of grapes: Mat.7:16, Luk.6:44, Rev.14:18. "σ. is properly the ripe grape-cluster as opposite to ὄμφαξ, cf. Gen.40:10, Job.15:33; as contrasted with βότρυς, it describes the grapes rather than the cluster on which they grow" (Swete, Apoc., 187 f.).†; (AS)

G4721.definition: (στέγω)  ; a roof: Mrk.2:4; of entering a house, εἰσέρχεσθαι ὑπὸ τὴν σ., Mat.8:8, Luk.7:6 (cf. MM, xxiii).†; (AS)

G4757.definition: a soldier: Mat.8:9, Mrk.15:16, Jhn.19:2, Act.10:7, al.; metaphorically, σ. Χριστοῦ Ἰησ., 2Ti.2:3.†; (AS)

G4765.definition: dimin. of στρουθός ; a sparrow: Mat.10:29, 31, Luk.12:6-7.†; (AS)

G4716.definition: 1. an upright pale or stake (Hom., Hdt., Thuc., al.) ; 2. In late writers (Diod., Plut., al.) of the Roman instrument of crucifixion, the Cross: of the Cross on which Christ suffered, Mat.27:32, 40 27:42, Mrk.15:21, 30 15:32, Luk.23:26, Jhn.19:17, 19 19:25, 31, Col.2:14, Heb.12:2; θάνατος σταυροῦ, Php.2:8; τ. αἷμα τοῦ σ., Col.1:20. Metaphorical, in proverbial sayings: αἴρειν (λαμβάνειν, βαστάζειν) τὸν σ., Mat.10:38…

G4700.definition: ashes: Heb.9:13; ἐν σάκκῳ καὶ σ. (Isa.58:5, Jhn.3:6, Dan LXX 9:3, al.), Mat.11:21, Luk.10:13.†; (AS)

G4702.definition: (σπείρω)  ; fit for sowing, sown; as subst., τὰ σ., corn-fields: Mat.12:1, Mrk.2:23, Luk.6:1.†; (AS)

G4719.definition: an ear of corn: Mat.12:1, Mrk.2:23 4:28, Luk.6:1.†; (AS)

G4712.definition: στάδιον, -ου, τό pl., στάδια (Jhn.6:19, T), and metapl., στάδιοι (see B1., 9, 1),; a stadium, i.e. ; 1. a measure of length = 600 Greek feet or 1⁄8 of a Roman mile Mat.14:24 (Rec., WH, txt., R, mg.), Luk.24:13, Jhn.6:19 11:18, Rev.14:20 21:16, and, this being the length of the Olympic course, ; 2. a race-course: 1Co.9:24.†; (AS)

G4711.definition: 131., § 6, 7), -ίδος, ἡ, ; a flexible mat-basket for carrying provisions: Mat.15:37 16:10, Mrk.8:8, 20 Act.9:25 (see: κόφινος).†; (AS)

G4768.definition: (στυγνός, sombre, gloomy, sullen, Isa.5:17, Wis.17:5, Dan LXX 2:12*),  ; to have a sombre, gloomy appearance: of the human countenance (RV, his countenance fell), Mrk.10:22; of the sky (so στυγνότης, Polyb., iv, 21, 1), Mat.16:3 (, R, mg., om.).†; (AS)

G4715.definition: a stater; (a) a weight; (b) a coin (used by late writers of the Greek τετράδραχμον): Mat.17:27 26:16, WH, mg.†; (AS)

G4717.definition: (σταυρός),  ; 1. to fence with pales, impalisade (Thuc.). ; 2. In late writers (Polyb., FlJ; but ἀνασταυρόω is more common) to crucify: with accusative of person(s), Mat.20:19 23:34 26:2 27:22 ff. Mat.28:5, Mrk.15:16 ff. Mrk.16:6, Luk.23:21, 23 23:33 24:7, 20, Jhn.19:6 ff., Act.2:36 4:10, 1Co.1:13 1:23 2:2 2:8, 2Co.13:4, Gal.3:1, Rev.11:8; metaphorically, Gal.5:24 6:14.†; (AS)

G4766.definition: (seeBl., § 23, 1; Veitch, see word),  ; to spread: ἱμάτια ἐν τ. ὁδῷ (εἰς τ. ὁδόν), Mat.21:8, Mrk.11:8; of making a bed, στρῶσον (sc. τ. κλίνην) σεαυτῷ, Act.9:34; of furnishing a room, ἐστρωμένον, spread with carpets or carpeted couches (cf. Eze.23:41), Mrk.14:15, Luk.22:12.†; (AS)

G4753.definition: (στρατεύω),  ; 1. = στρατεία (Hdt., al.). ; 2. an army, a host: pl., Mat.22:7, Rev.9:16 19:14, 19; = soldiers, company of soldiers, Act.23:10, 27; pl., Luk.23:11.†; (AS)

G4735.definition: (στέφω, to encircle),  ; 1. that which surrounds or encompasses (as a wall, a crowd: Hom., al.). ; 2. a crown, i.e. the wreath, garland or chaplet given as a prize for victory, as a festal ornament, or as a public honour for disting­uished service or personal worth (so to sovereigns, especially on the occasion of a παρουσία, which see; cf. Deiss., LAE, 372 ff.; on its use in LXX for the golden crown of royalty…

G4739.definition: WH, App., 169; Kennedy, Sources, 158; M, Pr., 238; MM, xxiii),; = ἵστημι, to stand: Mrk.3:31 11:25, Jhn.1:26, Rev.12:4 (ἕστηκεν T). Metaphorical, to stand firm, stand fast: absol., Gal.5:1 (but see Field, Notes, 189 f.), 2Th.2:15; before ἐν, Jhn.8:44 (ἕστηκεν, T, R, mg.), 1Co.16:13, Php.1:27 4:1; with dative, Rom.14:4.†; (AS)

G4703.definition: (σπείρω),  ; = σπορά, ; 1. sowing or seedtime. ; 2. seed sown (so usually in late Gk.): Mrk.4:26-27, Luk.8:5, 11, 2Co.9:10 a (LTr.); metaphorically, of almsgiving, 2Co.9:10 b.†; (AS)

G4773.definition: σνγγενής, -ές (dative pl., -εῦσιν, Mrk.6:4, Luk.2:44, as though from -εύς, see Swete, Mk., l.with; Bl., § 8, 6; cf. 1Ma.10:89 A א2 *;) ; (σύν, γένος),  ; 1. congenital, natural, innate. ; 2. akin to; as subst., a kinsman: Mrk.6:4, Luk.1:58 2:44 14:12 21:16, Jhn.18:26, Act.10:24; of tribal kinship, Rom.9:3 16:7, 11 16:21.†; SYN.: ἴδιος, οἰκεῖος (which see) (AS)

G4710.definition: (σπεύδω),  ; 1. haste, speed: μετὰ σ. (Wis.19:2), Mrk.6:25, Luk.1:39. ; 2. zeal, diligence, earnestness: Rom.12:11, 2Co.7:11-12 8:7-8; ἐν σ., Rom.12:8 (see M, Pr, 104); before ὑπέρ, 2Co.8:16; σπουδὴν ἐνδείκνυσθαι, Heb.6:11; σ. παρεισφέρειν, 2Pe.1:5; πᾶσαν σ. ποιεῖσθαι, Ju 3 (see MM, xxiii; M, Pr., 214; Deiss., BS, 361, 364).†; (AS)

G4727.definition: to groan ("the word denotes feeling which is internal and unexpressed," Mayor, Ja., 162): Mrk.7:34, 2Co.5:2 5:4, Heb.13:17, Jas.5:9 (EV, murmur); ἐν ἑαυτοῖς, Rom.8:23 (cf. ἀνα-, συ(ν)-στενάζω).†; SYN.: see: κλαίω (AS)

G4746.definition: στοιβάς, see: στιβάς.; στιβάς, -άδος, ἡ,; a litter of leaves or rushes: pl., Mrk.11:8 (Rec. στοιβ-).†; (AS)

G4749.definition: (στέλλω),  ; 1 1, an equipment, an armament (Æsch.). ; 2. Equipment in clothes, apparel, esp. flowing raiment, a festal robe: (cf. Jon.3:6, Est.8:15, 1Ma.6:15): Mrk.12:38 16:5, Luk.15:22 20:46, Rev.6:11 7:9, 13-14 22:14.†; (AS)

G4775.definition: συν-κάθημαι; (Rec. συγκ-),  ; to sit together or with: with dative, Act.26:30; before μετά, with genitive, Mrk.14:54.†; (AS)

G4714.definition: (ἵστημι),  ; 1. a standing, place, status: σ. ἔχειν (Polyb., v, 5, 3; and cf. Lat. locum habere), Heb.9:8. ; 2. insurrection, sedition: Mrk.15:7, Luk.23:19, 25, Act.19:40 24:5. ; 3. In poets and late prose, strife, dissension (cf. MM, xxiii) Act.15:2 23:7, 10.†; (AS)

G4779.definition: συν-καλέω; (Rec. συγκ-), -ῶ,  ; to call together: with accusative, Mrk.15:16, Luk.15:6, 9 (seel. -εῖται, see B1., § 55, 1), Act.5:21. Mid., to call together to oneself: Luk.9:1 (and seel. in Luk.15:6, 9 see supr.) Luk.23:13, Act.10:24 28:17.†; (AS)

G4723.definition: στεῖρος, -ον also -α, -ον,; barren: of a woman, Luk.1:7, 36 23:29, Gal.4:27" (LXX) .†; (AS)

G4796.definition: συν-χαίρω; (Rec. συγ-),  ; 1. to rejoice with: with dative of person(s), Luk.1:58 15:6, 9, Php.2:17-18, EV; with dative of thing(s), 1Co.12:26 13:6. ; 2. to congratulate (Æschin., Polyb., al.): Phi, l.with (Lft., in I.; cf. MM, xxiv).†; (AS)

G4772.definition: (συγγενής),  ; 1. kinship. ; 2. By meton., kinsfolk, kindred: Luk.1:61, Act.7:3, 14 †; (AS)

G4756.definition: 1. = στρατός, an army, a host: of angels (3Ki.22:19, al.), Luk.2:13; of the stars of heaven (Jer.8:2, 2Ch.33:3), Act.7:42. ; 2. As sometimes in cl. (poët.), = στρατεία: 2Co.10:4, T (WH, RV, στρατεία).†; (AS)

G4754.definition: (στρατός, an encamped army),  ; used of the general, to make war, do battle, and (chiefly) of the soldiers serving under him, to serve as a soldier: Luk.3:14, 1Co.9:7, 2Ti.2:4. Metaphorical (cf. MM, ii, xxiii), of spiritual conflict, to war, make war: 2Co.10:3, 1Ti.1:18, Jas.4:1, 1Pe.2:11.†; (AS)

G4743.definition: (στίζω, to prick),  ; a prick, a point; metaphorically, σ. χρόνου, a moment: Luk.4:5.†; (AS)

G4788.definition: συν-κλείω; (Rec. συγκ-),  ; to shut together, enclose, shut in on all sides: of a catch of fish, Luk.5:6; metaphorically (Psa.31:9, al.), Rom.11:32, Gal.3:22-23.†; (AS)

G4709.definition: adv. (σπουδαῖος),  ; 1. with haste or zeal, i.e. earnestly, zealously, diligently: Luk.7:4, 2Ti.1:17, Tit.3:13; compar., -οτέρως, Php.2:28 (RV, Lft., Weymouth, al., but see infr.) ; 2. hastily, speedily: compar., -οτέρως, Php.2:28 (Thayer, Zorell, see word; ICC, in l, al., but see supr.).†; (AS)

G4741.definition: to fix, set fast, make fast: Luk.16:26; τ. πρόσωτον (Eze.6:2 13:17, al.; see Dalman, Words, 30 f.), Luk.9:51. Metaphorical, to confirm, establish: with, accusative, Luk.22:32, Act.18:23, Rom.1:11 16:25, 1Th.3:2 3:13, 2Th.3:3, Jas.5:8, 1Pe.5:10, Rev.3:2; id. before ἐν, 2Th.2:17, 2Pe.1:12.†; (AS)

G4795.definition: (συγκυρέω, to happen),  (more frequently in late writers, συγκύρησις, -ημα), ; chance, coincidence: κατὰ σ. (see MM, xxiii), Luk.10:31 (Hippocr., Eccl.).†; (AS)

G4780.definition: συν-καλύπτω; (Rec. συγκ-),  ; to veil or cover completely: with accusative, pass., Luk.12:2.†; (AS)

G4794.definition: συν-κύπτω; (Rec. συγκ-),  ; 1. to bend forwards (Arist., al.). ; 2. to be bowed down: Luk.13:11.†; (AS)

G4738.definition: the breast: Jhn.13:25 21:10, Rev.15:6; as a sign of penitence, τύπτειν (εἰς) τὸ σ., Luk.18:13 23:48,†; (AS)

G4760.definition: στρατό-πεδον, -ου, τό; (στρατός + πέδον, a plain),  ; (a) a military camp; (b) an army: Luk.21:20.†; (AS)

G4755.definition: (στραός, ἄγω),  ; 1. a military commander, a general (Hdt., al.). ; 2. A civic commander, a governor, magistrate (Hdt., Xen., al.): Act.16:20, 22 16:35-36, 38. ; 3. The commander of the Levitical guard of the Temple, ὁ σ. τ. ἱεροῦ (EV, captain of the Temple): Act.4:1 5:24, 26; pl., Luk.22:4, 52.†; SYN.: ἄρχων (cf. EGT on Act.16:20; Ramsay, St. Paul, 217). (AS)

G4776.definition: περι-καθ-ίζω; 1. to invest, besiege (Diod., 4Ki.6:24, 1Ma.11:61, al.). ; 2. to sit around: Luk.22:55, L, txt.; † (AS)

G4784.definition: συν-κατα-τίθημι; (Rec. συγκ-),  ; to deposit together. Mid., to deposit one's vote with, hence, to agree with, assent to: with dative, Luk.23:51.†; (AS)

G4798.definition: συν-χράομαι; (Rec. συγ-), -ῶμαι,  ; to use together with. Metaphorical, with dative of person(s), to associate with: Jhn.4:9 (Polyb., a1.).†; (AS)

G4745.definition: a portico: Jhn.5:2; used of the covered colonnade in the Temple (EV, porch), Jhn.10:23 Act.3:11 5:12 †; (AS)

G4785.definition: συν-κατα-ψηφίζω (Rec. συγκ-), ; 1. to condemn with or together (Plut., Themist., 21). ; 2. to vote one a place among: pass., Act.1:26. Not elsewhere .†; (AS)

G4797.definition: συν-χέω; (Rec. συγ-),  ; to pour together, commingle, confuse; metaphorically, confound, throw into confusion, stir up trouble: Act.21:27 (cf. συν-χύννω).†; (AS)

G4732.definition: (στερεός),  ; (a) to make firm or solid; (b) to strengthen, make strong; with accusative of person(s), Act.3:16; τ. βάσεις, pass., Act.3:7. Metaphorical (cf. Je, l.with): τ. πίστει, pass., Act.16:5.†; (AS)

G4787.definition: συν-κινέω (Rec. συγκ-), -ῶ, ; to move together. Metaphorical, to excite, stir up: τ. λαόν, Act.6:12 (Arist., Polyb., al.).†; (AS)

G4792.definition: συν-κομίζω; (Rec. συγκ-),  ; 1. to bring together, collect (Hdt., Xen., al.). ; 2. to take up a body for burial (Soph., Aj., 1048): Act.8:2 (see Field, Notes, 116).†; (AS)

G4725.definition: (στέφω, to put around, enwreath) ; a wreath, garland: as used in sacrifices, Act.14:13.†; (AS)

G4799.definition: (συγχέω),  ; confusion: of a popular uproar, Act.19:29.†; (AS)

G4748.definition: (στοῖχος, a row),  ; to be in rows (of waves, plants, etc., as well as of men), to walk in line (esp. of marching in file to battle; Xen., Cyr., vi, 3, 34, al.). Metaphorical, in late writers, to walk by rule: Act.21:24; with dative, to walk by or in (as a rule of life), Rom.4:12 (cf. MM, xxiii), Gal.5:25 6:16, Php.3:16 (cf. συν-στοιχέω).†; (AS)

G4782.definition: συν-κατα-βαίνω; (Rec. συγκ-),  ; to go down with: Act.25:5. In late writers also metaphorically (Wis, l.with), to condescend, on WH. see Rutherford, NPhr., 485 f.†; (AS)

G4730.definition: narrowness of space, want of room (Thuc., al.). Metaphorical (Ken., Polyb., Deu.28:53, Wis.5:3, al.), difficulty, distress: θλίψις καὶ (ἢ) σ., Rom.2:9 8:35 (EV, anguish); pl. (cf. Bl., § 32, 6; WM, 220), 2Co.6:4 12:10.†; SYN.: θλίψις, q.v (AS)

G4789.definition: συν-κληρο-νόμος (Rec. συγκ-), -ου, ὁ ; a co-inheritor, fellow-heir: Rom.8:17, Eph.3:6; with genitive of thing(s), Heb.11:9, 1Pe.3:7 (for exx., see Deiss., LAE, 88 f.).†; (AS)

G4781.definition: συν-κάμπτω; (Rec. συγκ-),  ; to bend completely, bend together: τ. νῶτον, figuratively, Rom.11:10 (LXX).†; (AS)

G4791.definition: συν-κοινωνός (Rec. συγκ-), όν, ; partaking jointly of: with genitive of thing(s), Rom.11:17, 1Co.9:23; id. with genitive of person(s), Php.1:7; before ἐν, Rev.1:9.†; (AS)

G4720.definition: Stachys: Rom.16:9 (see Lft., Phi., 174; MM, xxiii).†; (AS)

G4793.definition: συν-κρίνω (Rec. συγκ-); 1. to compound, combine: 1Co.2:13, R, mg.1 (Lft., Notes, 180 f.). ; 2. In Arist. and later writers (Wis.7:29, a1.) = παραβάλλω, to compare: 1Co, l.with, R, txt. (Field, Notes, 168), 2Co.10:12 ; 3. In LXX, of dreams, to interpret (Gen.40:8, 1Co, l.with, R, mg. 2 (but see reff. supr.).†; (AS)

G4774.definition: συν-γνώμη (Rec. συγγ-), -ης, ἡ; (συγγιγνώσκω, (a) to agree with; (b) to pardon),  ; 1. confession. ; 2. fellow feeling; hence, concession, allowance: 1Co.7:6 (see ICC, in l). ; 3. pardon.†; (AS)

G4722.definition: (cf. Lat. tego),  ; 1. prop., to cover closely, to protect by covering, esp. to keep water in or out (Soph., Plat., al.). ; 2. to cover, keep secret, conceal (Sir, l.with, Polyb., al.): 1Co.13:7, R, mg. ; 3. By covering to ward of, bear up under, endure (for exx., see, Lft., Notes, 40; M, Th., 36): 1Co.9:12 13:7, 1Th.3:1 3:5.†; (AS)

G4786.definition: συν-κεράννυμι; (Rec. συγκ-),  ; to mix or blend together, compound: with accusative, 1Co.12:24; ptcp. pf. pass., Heb.4:2, T, WH, mg., R, mg.; id., of persons, with dative instr., to be united with, agree with, ib., WH, txt., R, txt. (see Westc., in l).†; (AS)

G4729.definition: στενο-χωρέω, -ῶ; (στενός + χῶρος, space)  ; 1. to be straitened (cf. Isa.49:19); metaphorically, to be anxious (Hipp., al.). ; 2. In late writers, trans., to straiten, compress (LXX, Diod., al.; π. ap. MM, xxiii): pass., trop., 2Co.4:8 6:12.†; (AS)

G4783.definition: συν-κατά-θεσις (Rec συγκ-), -εως, ἡ; (συνκατατίθημι) ; concord, agreement: 2Co.6:16 (Polyb., Plut., al.).†; (AS)

G4705.definition: (σπουδή),  ; in haste; hence, zealous, eager, diligent, earnest: before ἐν, 2Co.8:22; compar., -οτεροσς 2Co.8:17 (here in superl. sense, see Bl., § 44, 3) 2Co.8:22.†; (AS)

G4724.definition: 1. prop., to set, place, arrange, fit out; hence, mid., to set oneself for, prepare (Wis, xi Mac, ll. with). ; 2. to bring together, gather up (in Hom. of furling sails), hence to restrain, check; mid., to restrain or withdraw oneself, hold aloof, avoid: 2Co.8:20; before ἀπό, 2Th.3:6 ; (cf. ἀπο-, ἐξ-απο-, συν-απο-, δια-, ἐπι-, κατα-, συ(ν)-, ὑπο-στέλλω).†; (AS)

G4752.definition: (οτρατεύω),  ; an expedition, a campaign, warfare: metaphorically, 2Co.10:4 (-τιά, T), 1Ti.1:18.†; (AS)

G4769.definition: a pillar, regarded especially as a support: σ. πυρός, Rev.10:1; σ. ἐν τ. ναῷ, figuratively, Rev.3:12, Metaphorical, Gal.2:9; τ. ἀληθείας, 1Ti.3:15.†; (AS)

G4704.definition: (σπουδή),  ; to make haste; hence, to be zealous or eager, to give diligence: with inf. (see M, Pr., 205 f.), Gal.2:10, Eph.4:3, 1Th.2:17, 2Ti.2:15 4:9 4:21, Tit.3:12, Heb.4:11, 2Pe.1:10 3:14; with accusative and inf. (on this construction see Mayor in l; MM, xxiii), 2Pe.1:15 (for other constructions see LS, see word).†; (AS)

Heb.5:12; πτωχὰ σ., Gal.4:9; σ. τοῦ κόσμου, Gal.4:3, Col.2:8, 20 (but see infr.). ; 4. The material elements of the universe (Plat.; LXX, ll. with): 2Pe.3:10 3:12. ; 5. The heavenly bodies (Ding.…

G4742.definition: (στίζω, to prick),  ; a tattoed mark or brand: τὰ σ. τοῦ Ἰησοῦ, Gal.6:17 (see Lft., in l; Deiss., BS, 349; LAE, 303; MM, xxiii).†; (AS)

G4790.definition: συν-κοινωνέω (Rec. συγκ-), -ῶ, ; to have fellowship with or in (in cl., with genitive of thing(s), dative of person(s)): with dative of thing(s), Eph.5:11, Rev.18:4; id. with genitive of person(s), Php.4:14.†; (AS)

G4708.definition: earnestly, zealously, with vigor; (compar.) all the more eager, with special urgency eagerly ; earnestly, eagerly, diligently, Lk. 7:4; 2Tim. 1:17; Tit. 3:13; comparative σπουδαιοτέρως, more earnestly, with special urgency, Phil. 2:28

G4733.definition: (στερεόω),  ; a solid body; (a) a support, foundation (Arist., al.); metaphorically, strength (Psa.17:1-15 70:1-5, 1Mac, ll. with); steadfastness, firmness: τ. πίστεως, Col.2:5; (b) the dome of heaven (believed to be a solid canopy), the firmament (LXX).†; (AS)

G4751.definition: (στόμα), ; prop., a mouth, an opening; (a) in early Gk. writers, the throat; (b) of the opening of the stomach (Arist.); (with) in later writers (Plut., al.), the stomach: 1Ti.5:23.†; (AS)

G4777.definition: συν-κακοπαθέω (Rec. συγκ-), -ῶ, ; to bear evil treatment along with, take one's share of ill-treatment: 2Ti.2:3; with dative commod., τ. εὐαγγελίῳ, 2Ti.2:18.†; (AS)

G4758.definition: (στρατός, λέγω), ; to levy a troop, enlist soldiers: 2Ti.2:4 (Diod., Plut., al.).†; (AS)

G4737.definition: (στέφανος),  ; with accusative of person(s), ; to crown: of a victor, 2Ti.2:5. Metaphorical, δόξῃ κ. τιμῇ, Heb.2:7, 9" (LXX) .†; (AS)

G4731.definition: hard, firm, solid: τροψή, Heb.5:12, 14; θεμέλιος, figuratively, 2Ti.2:19. Metaphorical, ; (a) in bad sense, hard, cruel (Hom., al.); (b) in good sense, steadfast, firm: τ. πίστει, 1Pe.5:9.†; (AS)

G4713.definition: στάρνος, -ου (ὁ and), ἡ; prop., an earthen jar for racking off wine, hence, generally, a jar: Heb.9:4.†; (AS)

G4778.definition: συν-κακουχέομαι (Rec. συγκ-), -οῦμαι, pass. ; to endure adversity with: with dative of person(s), Heb.11:25. Not elsewhere.†; (AS)

G4701.definition: (σπείρω),  ; 1. a sowing. ; 2. seedtime. ; 3. seed sown (of human offspring, Soph., Tr., 316, 420): 1Pe.1:23 ; (cf. σπέρμα, and see Milligan, NTD, 105 f.).†; (AS)

G4761.definition: (στρέφω),  ; to twist, torture. Metaphorical (cf. 2Ki, l.with), to twist or pervert language: 2Pe.3:16.†; (AS)

G4740.definition: (στηρίζω),  ; 1. a setting firmly, supporting. ; 2. fixedness, firmness, steadfastness: 2Pe.3:17.†; (AS)

G4764.definition: (cf. Lat. strenuus),  ; insolent luxury, wantonness: Rev.18:3 (a late word, first found in a Comic poet, B.C. 300, see Kennedy, Sources, 41, cf. στρηνιάω).†; (AS)

G4763.definition: (στρῆνος, which see),  ; a word which first appears in the middle comedy (Rutherford, NPhr., 475 f.), to run riot, wax wanton: Rev.18:7-9 (cf. κατα-στρηνιάω).†; SYN.: σπαταλάω (which see), τρυφάω (AS)
